create_DPTDepthModel: create a DPTDepthModel instance with a specified backbone and optional pretrained weight path
run_DPTDepthModel_forward: run a forward pass through DPTDepthModel to predict monocular depth from an input image tensor
build_DPT_with_custom_head: build a DPT model with a custom output head module and chosen transformer backbone
create_fusion_block: create a FeatureFusionBlock_custom instance via _make_fusion_block with given feature count and batch norm flag
review_DPT_backbone_hooks: review the DPT class hook configurations for supported backbones like ViT, Swin, BEiT, and LeViT
